# State Class View (variant): Natural resource and environmental programme manager (local)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> All task importance, time share, critical, needed-at-entry and target-level values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Credential gates and sign-off are shown only as drafts until an E-labelled source is attached.

- **Role:** Natural resource and environmental programme manager (`seed:R13-resource-program-manager`, P1); authority position (editorial): regulator
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.1.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (proposed), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Formulate, justify and execute public budgets across appropriations cycles — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Brief decision-makers and elected officials for authoritative decisions — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Govern enterprise environmental data and AI portfolios — lead L4, strategic L5
- Elicit, document and transfer tacit and institutional knowledge before people leave — senior L3, lead L3, strategic L4
- Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality — senior L3, lead L3, strategic L4
- Design and administer cross-jurisdictional stewardship agreements — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Assess the durability and reversal risk of policy choices and time actions to policy windows — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L5
- Administer contracts, grants and intergovernmental agreements — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Prepare and revise management plans for publicly held lands — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
- Design developmental work experiences that preserve the formation of professional judgment — senior L3, lead L4, strategic L4
